name: Covert Asset Check-In
description: Hardware implants placed during the engagement must be periodically verified as operational. The LAN Turtle and Wi-Fi Pineapple provide network-based check-in capability that the operator can monitor remotely. The ESPKey stores captured data locally and requires physical retrieval to confirm capture. Establishing a check-in cadence and a go/no-go threshold for retrieval ensures planted assets are recovered before being discovered or becoming inoperable.

blue.det: Network monitoring detects periodic beacon from implant; RF sweep detects implant signal; physical discovery during post-engagement sweep.
blue.cm: TSCM sweep after engagement; NAC detecting implant periodic check-in traffic; RF monitoring for unusual signals; thorough physical sweep of all areas accessed during engagement.
